listing.name: XIII Weapons / Ships
listing.summary: This submod includes all 13th Battlegroup ships, sporting high armor, high forward speed, but a steep cost in maneuverability. Also included are a set of converted themed ballistic weaponry focused on extended magazines and themed fighter wings.
listing.aiSummary: Adds all 13th Battlegroup ships, themed ballistic weapons, fighter wings, and rare blueprints.

description:
This submod includes all 13th Battlegroup ships, sporting high armor,
high forward speed, but a steep cost in maneuverability. Also included
are a set of converted themed ballistic weaponry focused on extended
magazines and themed fighter wings. There is also a bounty for some
rare blueprints that can't be gained anywhere else.
